Bred by Mike Athy (New Zealand, before 2004).

rows.Bloom: Cream. Creamy yellow. Mild to strong, musk fragrance. Continuous (perpetual) bloom throughout the season.
rows.Habit: Medium, well-branched. Glossy, dark green foliage.
